senses.definition_en: to care, heed, study, strive, seek, work

examples.english: Forthy they who seek doings, / not caring / of virtues, go seeking / their content / with nor repair nor amend / 't is such loss / son, ward such wile / thee do not hend.
examples.ref: (Can we date this quote?), Santillana, Obras, published 1852, page 46:
examples.text: Ca los que buscan façienda / non curando / de virtudes van buscando / su contienda / sin reparo nin emienda / es tal dapño / fijo guarda tal engaño / non te prenda.
examples.translation: Forthy they who seek doings, / not caring / of virtues, go seeking / their content / with nor repair nor amend / 't is such loss / son, ward such wile / thee do not hend.

examples.english: they couldn't get them because they didn't care much to follow them.
examples.ref: (Can we date this quote?), Andrés Bernáldez, Historia de los Reyes Católicos D. Fernando y D.ª Isabel:
examples.text: no los pudieron alcanzar a causa que no curaron mucho de los seguir.
examples.translation: they couldn't get them because they didn't care much to follow them.

examples.english: Enter, care not, that we all are at home.
examples.ref: (Can we date this quote?), “act 9”, in La Celestina:
examples.text: Entra, no cures, que todos somos de casa.
examples.translation: Enter, care not, that we all are at home.

examples.english: Receive you in all this my willingness, as the rest doesn't satisfy me much, nor I care that it satisfy others.
examples.ref: (Can we date this quote?), Fr. L. de León, edited by P. Merino, Obras, volume 4, published 1885, page 6:
examples.text: Vmd. reciba en todo esto mi voluntad, que lo demás no me satisface mucho, ni curo que satisfaga a otros.
examples.translation: Receive you in all this my willingness, as the rest doesn't satisfy me much, nor I care that it satisfy others.

glosses: to care, heed, study, strive, seek, work

senses.definition_en: to cure, heal (body, soul, mind, heart); nurse, treat, dress (a wound)

examples.english: They were in the city of Esbrique some days healing of the wounds.
examples.ref: (Can we date this quote?), Libros de Caballerías, volume 11, Bailly/Bailliere, Nueva Biblioteca de Autores Españoles, published 1908, page 28:
examples.text: Estuvieron en la ciudad de Esbrique algunos días curándose de las heridas.
examples.translation: They were in the city of Esbrique some days healing of the wounds.

examples.english: Valencia has a famous hospital / where the frantic are cured / with great cleanness and careful zeal.
examples.ref: (Can we date this quote?), Lope de Vega, Comedias, volume 24, Rivas, page 115:
examples.text: Tiene Valencia un hospital famoso / adonde los frenéticos se curan / con gran limpieza y celo cuidadoso.
examples.translation: Valencia has a famous hospital / where the frantic are cured / with great cleanness and careful zeal.

glosses: to cure, heal (body, soul, mind, heart); nurse, treat, dress (a wound)
